name: Pauper's Disguise
text: Affinity: Spades. This card loses 6 rank.
timing: Always on, for the engraved card
archetypes: Nil Champion, Blind Bidder; splash Discard Dominance
decision: Whether a hand whose spade is now six ranks lower is a nil, or a contract bid one trick short.
opponent: Hidden until played, then an ordinary seven; no loss of agency.
aiNote: Judge nil and count tricks as if the engraved card were its lowered rank.
rationale: A spade is the hardest card to keep from winning on a nil, since it can't be thrown off safely once spades are led, so the affinity puts the lowering where it matters. Six ranks turns an ace into an eight and a queen into a six, and a low spade becomes a two, so the gain varies from hand to hand. In contract rounds it costs about half a trick at most, which keeps it a cheap common.
deviation: Affinity changed from King to Spade, so the lowered card varies from hand to hand.
